title: Amazing Aromatic Polish Penne Pasta
description: This resinous and fluffy Polish dish is a midnight craving featuring penne pasta and nigiri-shaping, perfect for vegetarians. It combines the richness of mushrooms and the comfort of penne pasta.
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook the penne pasta according to the package instructions until al dente.
In a large skillet, heat the olive oil over medium heat and saute the chopped onion until translucent.
Add the sliced mushrooms to the skillet and cook until they release their liquid and start to brown.
Add the minced garlic to the skillet and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly to prevent burning.
In a large bowl, combine the cooked penne pasta, sauteed mushroom mixture, and grated cheddar cheese.
In a small bowl, whisk together the vegetable broth, dried thyme, salt, and black pepper, then pour the mixture over the pasta and toss to combine.
Using your hands, shape the pasta mixture into small nigiri-shaped pieces.
Serve the Amazing Aromatic Polish Penne Pasta hot, garnished with chopped fresh parsley if desired.
